text: 秘鲁中央储备银行行长贝拉尔德18日说，因厄尔尼诺现象造成的影响超出预期，秘鲁央行将2026年秘鲁经济增长预期从此前的3.4%下调至3.2%。（新华社）
text_en: Peru central bank governor Velarde said on the 18th that because the impact of El Nino exceeded expectations, Peru's central bank will lower its 2026 economic growth forecast for Peru from the previous 3.4% to 3.2%. (Xinhua News Agency)
